## ✨ Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you want to add.

## 🎯 Use Case / Problem
Describe the problem this feature would solve:

- What pain point does it address?
- Who would benefit? (Data analysts, data engineers, end users?)
- Why is it important?

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe your proposed implementation approach:

### Approach A:
- How it would work
- Implementation details
- Estimated effort

### Approach B (Alternative):
- ...

## 📊 Impact & Benefits
- Performance improvement: [e.g., "50% faster query execution"]
- Cost savings: [e.g., "80% reduction in LLM calls"]
- New capabilities: [list new abilities]
- User experience: [how does it improve UX?]

## 📚 Acceptance Criteria
What needs to be true for this feature to be "done"?

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Tests written with 80%+ coverage
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Backward compatible

## 🔗 Related Issues
Link related issues or discussions:
- Closes #123
- Related to #456
- Discussed in #789

## 🏗️ Architecture Notes
Any architectural considerations or decisions?

```
Affected components:
- agent_graph.py
- semantic_layer.py
- agent_tools.py

Breaking changes: [Yes/No]
```

## 📈 Metrics
How would you measure success?

- Query accuracy: [e.g., "92% on multi-table queries"]
- Performance: [e.g., "< 2s latency"]
- Adoption: [e.g., "50% of users enable this feature"]

## 🔄 Dependencies
Does this depend on other features or PRs?

- [ ] Depends on #123
- [ ] Blocks #456
- [ ] Independent
